content.short: HyperBrick is a bin-based dynamic liquidity market maker DEX on HyperEVM.
content.description: HyperBrick organises liquidity into discrete bins rather than a continuous curve, which lets fees adjust with volatility and gives providers exact control over the prices they quote at. Bin-based designs trade some elegance for precision, and suit assets that trade in tight bands most of the time.
content.meta: Liquidity organised into discrete bins, letting fees move with volatility on HyperEVM.
